title: Weight and Capacity
introduction: ‘Weight and Capacity’ is developed as a mathematical investigation rather than a list of rules. The chapter connects mass, capacity, units, measurement, comparison. Learners are expected to represent quantities or relationships, choose a strategy, calculate carefully, check the result and explain the reasoning.
